summary: Frontend testing (390x844) of Move-in/Move-out Inspection + Deposit Statement. CRITICAL blocker found & FIXED: root Gate in app/_layout.tsx redirected /statement/* and /inspection/* to Home (SHARED list lacked 'statement','inspection') — every new screen was unreachable. After fix all requested flows pass: landlord Home Move-outs card + Review statement; statement add charge (refund 1200->1050), price edit (->1000), Remove strikethrough/Undo, Change type check->damage, Approve -> Sent + Statement (PDF) (PDF 200 application/pdf); tenant Payments moveout-statement-card -> read-only statement -> Question this -> chat chip with question -> agent replied and asked landlord to drop charge; property detail Move-in record (video per area), Deposit statement / Move-out check buttons, Start move-out sheet for Maria; Maria capture flow (no-move-in warning, 1 of 8, library upload mp4 + jpg -> Saved / Saved · 1 photo(s), note persisted, Send check -> analyzed + draft statement with 3 check items). Privacy: Maria 404 / handyman 403 on Tom's inspection & statement. Jev playbook: real typed answers (noul in [0,1], choice in criteria, score probability map). No deprecated Expo packages (expo-video, expo-image-picker used).

critical.issue: No HTTP Range support (Range request returns 200 full body, no Accept-Ranges/206) and whole file buffered in memory. iOS AVPlayer/Safari require byte-range for mp4 playback -> inspection videos (record screen, statement 'Play from here') will likely fail on iOS. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:636-654

minor.issue: No-move-in check items titled '<Area>: no move-in record' -> UI shows 'Entry · Entry: no move-in record' (area duplicated).

ui_bugs.issue: SHARED routes lacked 'statement' and 'inspection' -> any push/deep link to /statement/<id> or /inspection/<id> immediately router.replace'd to Home. FIXED by tester.
Row didn't forward testID, so upload-state-<areaKey> (and other Row testIDs) never rendered. FIXED by tester.
Landlord-added items show pill 'Added by you' to the tenant; should read 'Added by landlord' when !isLandlord. Ref: app/statement/[id].tsx:57

Landlord can approve with unresolved 'Check' items and with $0 'Charge' items (changing type to Charge sets $0, no estimate). Tenant then sees a 'Check these' section and AI text 'landlord should look'. Consider blocking/warning before approve and hiding internal text for tenant.

ui_bugs.component: Tenant chat quick-reply from Question this
ui_bugs.issue: Chip text contains internal item id ('item 095bff8076fd4111'), and chip persists after sending (q param stays) -> easy duplicate dispute.

issues: Text 'CA: 21 days · 21 days left' is redundant/confusing
Subtitle shows raw status 'analyzed' to the tenant
DateTimeField mode='date' web fallback shows only month chips — no day selection on web

react_native_issues.issue: expo-video VideoView doesn't render testID on web; wrapped in View with testID (tester fix). Reference: /app/frontend/src/inspect.tsx:32

Item is declared inside StatementScreen render -> new component type each render, remounts all items (loses typed price / focus) on any parent state change. Reference: /app/frontend/app/statement/[id].tsx:43

action_items: Add HTTP Range (206, Accept-Ranges, Content-Range) support to GET /api/files/{fid} for video playback on iOS
Tenant statement view: show 'Added by landlord' instead of 'Added by you'; hide/soften landlord-facing AI explanations
Warn/block Approve when 'Check' items remain unresolved or a Charge is $0
Remove internal item id from 'Question this' chip text and clear q param after sending
Move statement Item component out of StatementScreen render
De-duplicate area in no-move-in check item title; clean up Move-outs card countdown text; friendly status text for tenant record subtitle
Web date picker for move-out: allow day selection
critical_code_review_comments: Approve flow in statement/[id].tsx fetches /landlord/home to find the approval id — fragile; expose approval_id on statement or a /statements/{id}/approve endpoint
inspections.py is 782 lines (>700) — consider splitting AI analysis vs routes
Jev severity uses argmax of probabilities; fine. Jev missed a synthetic black 'hole' (kind none) — rely on PHASH safety net

success_rate.frontend: ~95% of requested flows pass after the Gate fix (0% before fix)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Not tested: tenant movein-check-card / ReviewNotes (Looks right) / Comparing screen — no tenant without a move-in exists in current data (Maria's analysis was instant since she has no move-in). Camera recording untestable on web. Playwright Chromium can't decode H.264 (video error 4 is env artifact). Run pytest with -p no:xdist -o addopts='' to see prints.
rca_of_issue: Gate useEffect in app/_layout.tsx replaces route when segs[0] not in SHARED; new route groups 'statement' and 'inspection' were never added -> immediate redirect to /(role). Reproduced via click and direct URL; fixed by adding both to SHARED.
